name: Happenee
description_en:
Happenee is an event-operations platform for organizations that repeatedly run internal, partner, public or exhibitor-led events. It combines registration, tickets, microsites, agendas, speakers, capacity controls, contacts, communications, apps and onsite check-in around a shared operating structure. The site also describes learning journeys and vehicle test-drive use cases.

Its emphasis is reusing processes across a programme while preserving current data. Public commercial access is a requirements discussion followed by an offer; no subscription amount or reliable metering schedule was established. Learning or test-drive examples should not be generalized into a full LMS or fleet-management system.
description_zh:
Happenee 面向反复开展内部、合作伙伴、公开或展商活动的组织，将报名、票据、微站、议程、讲者、容量、联系人、沟通、应用和现场签到放在共享运营结构中，也介绍学习旅程及车辆试驾场景。

重点是跨项目复用流程并保持数据当前。公开商业入口为需求讨论后提供方案，未确定订阅金额或可靠计量表。学习或试驾示例不能扩大为完整 LMS 或车队系统。

core_features.explanation_en: Use one speaker/agenda structure across microsite, app and communications.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以同一讲者/议程结构支撑微站、应用及沟通。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage per-session limits, choice groups and assignments.
core_features.explanation_zh: 管理每场上限、选择组和分配。

en: Reuse an internal conference structure while updating attendees, workshops and agenda.
zh: 复用内部会议结构，并更新人员、工作坊和议程。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Bring one real recurring format to the demo and verify a changed agenda, capacity exception and resulting report.
steps.zh: 携带真实重复活动形式参与演示，核对议程变更、容量异常及报表。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Not publicly specified; tailored commercial offer based on requirements.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Tailored offer after a requirements discussion. No amount, metering unit, contract term or sustained free use was disclosed in the read commercial page. Generic /pricing redirected to homepage, so no old amount retained. Confirm modules, hardware, support and integration costs in the proposal.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 需求讨论后提供定制方案，已读商业页未披露金额、计量、期限或持续免费使用。通用 /pricing 返回首页，因此不保留旧金额。提案需确认模块、硬件、支持和集成费用。

sources.title: Happenee | Event Operations Platform
sources.research_notes_en: Current recurring event-operations platform with shared contacts, agenda, capacities, microsites/apps, communications and onsite.

sources.title: Book a demo | Happenee
sources.research_notes_en: Actual book-a-demo commercial page offers a requirements call and tailored offer; generic /pricing returned homepage, no amount or billing unit disclosed.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Reuse configuration but validate current choices
sections.title_zh: 复用配置后仍核对当期选择
sections.en: The website describes repeatable event structures, shared contact groups, a single speaker record and agenda changes across app, microsite and emails. For an illustrative recurring internal conference, reuse the structure but replace dates, attendee groups and room capacity. Test a full workshop, an approved attendee change and a last-minute speaker update across the attendee surfaces rather than trusting only the organizer editor.
sections.zh: 官网描述可重复活动结构、共享联系人组、单一讲者记录，以及应用、微站和邮件中的议程变更。例如重复内部会议，可复用结构，但要更换日期、人员组和房间容量。应测试工作坊满额、已批准人员变更及临时讲者更新在参与者端的结果，而不只看编辑器。

sections.en: Happenee describes workshop assignment, networking, a branded 3D venue, QR check-in and a vehicle-booking-to-return scenario. These are vendor-described workflows, not proof that each is included in a universal package or meets a specific regulated policy. Ask for the exact booking conflict, access and handover behavior needed by the programme. No scan-speed, policy-compliance or synchronization benchmark was performed.
sections.zh: Happenee 介绍工作坊分配、交流、品牌 3D 场地、二维码签到，以及车辆预订至归还流程。这些是厂商描述，不证明全部包含在统一套餐或符合特定政策。应询问项目需要的预订冲突、访问及交接行为。本文未测试扫描速度、政策合规或同步。

sections.title_en: Request a scoped offer, with billing still unknown
sections.title_zh: 申请范围明确的方案，计费仍待确认
sections.en: The genuine commercial page asks about event frequency and operating model, then describes a call and a tailored offer. The guessed /pricing URL merely returned the homepage and is not a price source. No amount, event/attendee/user unit, contract term or ongoing free entitlement was verified. Include formats, portfolio, apps, hardware, integrations, onboarding and event-day support in the request; advertised response times are not an SLA.
sections.zh: 真实商业页询问活动频率与运营方式，说明通话后提供定制方案。猜测的 /pricing 只是返回首页，不能作为价格来源。本次未核实金额、按活动/人数/用户单位、合同期限或持续免费权益。需求应包含形式、活动组合、应用、硬件、集成、培训及活动日支持，宣传响应时间不是 SLA。

sections.title_en: Evaluate repeatable event operations and failure ownership
sections.title_zh: 评估重复运营及失败处理责任
sections.en: Happenee merits investigation when teams need consistent workflows across recurring or complex events. A minimal RSVP may need less setup. Pilot a changed registration, capacity exception, offline check-in and report export before operational use. The site advertises EU hosting, but exact contractual region, retention and recovery were not established. No source license, self-hosted package or live workflow was tested or verified.
sections.zh: 需要跨重复或复杂活动保持一致流程时可研究 Happenee，简易 RSVP 可能只需更少配置。运营前建议试验报名修改、容量异常、离线签到及报表导出。官网宣传欧盟托管，但准确合同地区、保留与恢复未确定。本次未测试真实流程，也未确认源码许可或自托管服务包。

research_gaps: No event, app, capacity rule, check-in, integration, report or recovery was tested.
Commercial amount, billing units, entitlement, contract terms, exact EU hosting, license, self-hosting and data recovery remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
